scope: Independent small synthetic review of actual helper; no full source/tile rebuild.

cases.name: Clipping a crossing region does not create tile-frame sides
Each clipped diagonal tile has unique linework

quantization.coordinateRoundingNote: One initial axis-rounding step is <=0.5 cell per axis, but this is not an end-to-end Hausdorff bound: valid_output can remove collapsed holes/parts; union noding and clipping also snap.
quantization.renderScale: One grid cell is 1/16 CSS px at a tile native zoom with 512px tiles. Overzoom amplifies this; at map z15 with z10 source it is 2px.
quantization.seamNote: Common global input grid avoids independently shifted data origins, but integer-grid clipping can slightly change diagonal slopes between adjacent buffers. Exact seam equality is not guaranteed; inspect sample magnitudes.
